# Genie Studio

> Genie Studio (Genie Media and Studio) is a full-service photography and videography studio based in Yendada, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. It produces podcast shoots, product shoots, corporate shoots, event shoots and professional shoots for brands, businesses, professionals and creators, handling each project from concept and on-site production through editing and final delivery.

## About Genie Studio

Genie Studio is the brand name of Genie Media and Studio, a creative studio operating from its own equipped production space in Yendada, Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India.

The studio covers both photography and video production. Work is handled end to end: understanding the client's goal, planning the shoot, producing it with professional cameras, lenses, lighting and audio equipment, then editing, retouching and delivering the finished files in the formats the client needs.

Genie Studio works with brands, businesses, startups, professionals and creators who need visual content for marketing, e-commerce, personal branding, corporate communication and social platforms.

- [Genie Studio Home](https://geniestudio.in/): Official Genie Studio website.
- [About Genie Studio](https://geniestudio.in/about): Background on the studio, its production spaces and how it works.
- [Portfolio](https://geniestudio.in/portfolio): Selected photography and videography work across all service categories.
- [Gallery](https://geniestudio.in/gallery): Visual gallery of shoots produced by Genie Studio.
- [Blog](https://geniestudio.in/blogs): Articles and guides on photography, videography and visual content.

## Podcast Shoots

Podcast production at the Genie Studio podcast studio in Visakhapatnam. Audio and video are recorded in the same session, so a client leaves with a video podcast for YouTube and social clips as well as the audio episode.

Included in a podcast shoot:

- Audio and video podcast recording
- Professional studio lighting
- Sound editing and mastering
- Platform-ready content delivery
- Podcast artwork design where required

Solo shows, two-person interviews and panel discussions are all supported; the studio is configured for the format before the session. The process runs consultation, studio setup, recording, editing and mastering, then delivery.

- [Podcast Shoots](https://geniestudio.in/services/podcast-shoots): Podcast studio and podcast production in Vizag.

## Product Shoots

Product photography and video built for e-commerce listings, catalogues, advertising and social content, aimed at improving engagement, trust and conversion.

- [Product Shoots](https://geniestudio.in/services/product-shoots): Product photography and video production.

## Corporate Shoots

Corporate photography and video for brand presence, leadership identity and workplace culture, including executive portraits, team photography and office and workplace coverage.

- [Corporate Shoots](https://geniestudio.in/services/corporate-shoots): Corporate photography and team portraits.

## Event Shoots

Photo and video coverage for corporate events, conferences, product launches and brand activations, from full-day coverage through to edited delivery.

- [Event Shoots](https://geniestudio.in/services/event-shoots): Event photography and videography in Visakhapatnam.

## Professional Shoots

Portrait photography for professionals, founders, creators and executives — personal branding portraits, headshots and profile photography.

- [Professional Shoots](https://geniestudio.in/services/professional-shoots): Personal branding portraits and professional headshots.

## Who Genie Studio Serves

Genie Studio works with:

- Brands and businesses that need marketing, product and brand visuals
- Startups and companies building out their visual identity
- Professionals, founders, executives and creators who need personal branding photography
- Podcast creators launching or running a show
- Organisations running conferences, launches and corporate events

- [Portfolio](https://geniestudio.in/portfolio): Examples of work produced for these clients.

## Why Choose Genie Studio

- A single studio covering both photography and videography, so one team handles the whole project
- An equipped production space in Yendada, Visakhapatnam, with professional cameras, lenses, studio lighting and video and audio equipment
- End-to-end handling: consultation and planning, production, editing and retouching, then final delivery in the formats required
- Podcast sessions that capture audio and video together rather than forcing a choice between them
- Packages shaped around the client's format and requirements, discussed during a free consultation
